cases.name: ignore CustomResourceDefinition
cases.input:
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: whatever
spec:
  containers:
  - image: whatever
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: whatever
spec:
  containers:
  - image: whatever

cases.name: legacy multiple images in containers
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: nginx:2.1.2
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: apache@12345
  - image: apache@12345

cases.name: legacy both containers and initContainers
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  initContainers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: apache:1.2.3
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: apache:3.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  initContainers:
  - image: apache:3.2.1
  - image: apache:1.2.3

cases.name: legacy updates at multiple depths
cases.input:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: nginx:1.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - image: nginx:1.2.1
      - image: apache:1.2.3
cases.expectedOutput:
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Foo
metadata:
  name: instance
spec:
  containers:
  - image: apache:3.2.1
  - image: tomcat:1.2.3
  template:
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - image: apache:3.2.1
      - image: apache:1.2.3

cases.name: new Tag
cases.input:
group: apps
apiVersion: v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: deploy1
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: nginx:1.7.9
        name: nginx-tagged
      - image: nginx:latest
        name: nginx-latest
      - image: foobar:1
        name: replaced-with-digest
      - image: postgres:1.8.0
        name: postgresdb
      initContainers:
      - image: nginx
        name: nginx-notag
      - image: nginx@sha256:111111111111111111
        name: nginx-sha256
      - image: alpine:1.8.0
        name: init-alpine
cases.expectedOutput:
group: apps
apiVersion: v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: deploy1
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: nginx:v2
        name: nginx-tagged
      - image: nginx:v2
        name: nginx-latest
      - image: foobar:1
        name: replaced-with-digest
      - image: postgres:1.8.0
        name: postgresdb
      initContainers:
      - image: nginx:v2
        name: nginx-notag
      - image: nginx:v2
        name: nginx-sha256
      - image: alpine:1.8.0
        name: init-alpine
